evidence.title: MP4 to Animated SVG Converter & Editor | Anim8

name: Anim8
summary: Converts MP4 and AI-generated video into an editable animated SVG and exports animated SVG, Lottie or MP4.
description: A converter and editor that turns MP4 or AI-generated video into one editable animated SVG. Motion is vectorized so every frame can be refined, then exported as animated SVG, Lottie or MP4.
contains: converts MP4 and AI-generated video to animated SVG
vectorizes motion into one editable SVG
exports animated SVG, Lottie or MP4
